comments.author: @shawnhenderson2091
comments.text: The season 3 finale is still one of the best moments of poetic justice on television, and you can really tell how the showrunners found their footing following that scene, its like the show was split into two awesome halves, the first 3 seasons established the characters and the world they lived in, building up to an awesome climax and then the next four seasons became a solid, character driven plot series that easily rivaled Breaking Bad and Game of Thrones, as it inexorably led to a bloody shakespearean end of everything.
